Core Pulse sensor host third-party notices

LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6, DiskInfoToolkit 1.1.2,
BlackSharp.Core 1.0.7, and RAMSPDToolkit-NDD 1.4.2 are distributed
under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Their original corresponding
source archives, including build files and copyright notices, accompany
this installer under sensors/third-party/source. The precise upstream
revisions and archive SHA-256 hashes are listed in source-manifest.json.
The libraries are unmodified. MPL-2.0.txt contains the license.

LibreHardwareMonitor includes PawnIO.Modules 0.1.6 under LGPL 2.1.
LGPL-2.1.txt and the corresponding upstream source archive are included.
Core Pulse does not install a PawnIO driver. The host uses the libraries
as separate DLLs. These DLLs can be replaced with compatible modified
versions. CorePulse.SensorHost-source contains the host sources and
locked dependencies to rebuild against modified libraries. No additional
terms restrict the modification of these components or reverse engineering
for debugging modifications as permitted by their respective licenses.

HidSharp 2.6.4: the original Apache 2.0 license and copyright notices
are preserved in its package notice folder.
Mono.Posix.NETStandard 1.0.0: the upstream Mono license linked by the
package is included as Mono-LICENSE.txt. The original package metadata
and copyright notices are preserved in its notice folder.
.NET and System.* components: MIT license and original third-party
notices are preserved in the corresponding package folders and
dotnet-LICENSE.TXT / dotnet-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT.

Rebuilding the host: install the SDK specified in global.json, place the
source folder in a writable directory, run dotnet restore --locked-mode,
then dotnet publish -c Release. To use a modified LHM library, replace its
PackageReference with a ProjectReference to the accompanying source;
restore and publish again. Compatible output can replace the DLLs in the
sensors directory without changing Core Pulse's frontend. Protocol version
1 and read-only settings must be retained for the desktop integration.
